fact: The World Bank project record says Djibouti's national Social Registry, housed at the Ministry of Social Affairs and Solidarities, had 515,730 people registered as of February 2025, with a target of 600,000.

President Guelleh said a mapping of poverty and precariousness was established in particular thanks to the social registry, and that State responses were tailored using this methodology (ADDS report).

President Guelleh said that for the first time a mapping of poverty and precariousness was established notably thanks to the registre social, enabling targeted public policies (Ministry of Social Affairs and Solidarity page).
